text: Today was a reflective day. I spent the morning reading a book on philosophy, which made me think deeply about life’s meaning. I love exploring abstract ideas and having intellectual discussions with my friends. However, I also get easily distracted when working on projects, sometimes leaving them unfinished. In the afternoon, I helped a friend with their coding project. I always try to be reliable and supportive when someone needs help. I find it difficult to say no, even when I'm already busy with my own work. Later, I went to a social event, but I felt a little out of place. I enjoy deep one-on-one conversations, but big groups drain my energy. Sometimes, I worry too much about what others think of me. I tend to overanalyze social interactions, wondering if I said something wrong. Before bed, I spent some time journaling and organizing my schedule. I like to plan my tasks ahead, but I often procrastinate when things feel overwhelming. Despite this, I always meet my deadlines because I don’t want to disappoint others. I also have a habit of reflecting on past experiences, sometimes replaying conversations in my head for hours. Overall, today was a mix of productivity, social interactions, and self-reflection. Some moments were rewarding, while others made me feel uncertain about myself. But at the end of the day, I remind myself that personal growth is a journey, not a destination. btw jene is my best friend.
